name: manual_777872
claim: Treat a signed refusal as proof only of the refused request, never of the absence of an earlier permit or intent; a retried signed artifact returns the original bytes, and a catch-up envelope stays separate, unsigned, and decided before the event is appended.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: refusal after issuance does not free a reservation; re-signing a retry or deciding catch-up after the append breaks idempotency and the one-object guarantee.

rationale: 2026-10-19: refusal after issuance does not free a reservation; re-signing a retry or deciding catch-up after the append breaks idempotency and the one-object guarantee.
